purpose: Per-ticket cost ceilings, evaluated by tools/breaker-check against tools/agent-metrics report output when --ticket is given. Changing a ceiling is a human decision, not an agent one.
enforcement: Read by tools/breaker-check's budget-exceeded check. Soft-skipped (never a hard failure) if tools/agent-metrics or its ledger is unavailable — this is a cost-observability control, not a security control, and must not block work when the measurement tool itself can't run.
